headline: Indian stock indices rally sharply as Sensex surges over 1,500 points driven by FII inflows and lower crude prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign fund inflows and foreign institutional investor (FII) buying buoyed market sentiment.
Lower global crude oil prices supported Indian equities and helped the rupee surge.
FMCG and private banking sectors led the broad market rally.
Positive momentum from reverse AI trade helped markets recoup nearly all 2026 losses.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,500 points while Nifty 50 reclaimed levels above 25,800.
The Indian rupee rose to an 8-month high aided by foreign inflows and low crude oil prices.
PNB partnered with Deutsche Bank to explore acquisition financing opportunities in India.
SEBI introduced a new rule effective Dec 24 allowing investors to carry KYC details across brokers without repetition.
summary: Indian benchmark indices posted strong gains on November 25, 2026, with the Sensex soaring over 1,500 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,800. The rally was fueled by robust foreign institutional buying, lower crude oil prices, and strong buying in private banks and FMCG stocks. Additionally, the rupee reached an 8-month high while bond markets gained ahead of the upcoming RBI policy meeting.
